title: C7 plan-stage decomposition verdict
description: The plan stage's structured output: C2 /planner's decomposition verdict (spec §3.1, §5.2; mirrors the planner's own decomposition-verdict schema, #967) that drives C7's split-vs-build decision. 'atomic' makes the node a build leaf; 'split' carves one child node per independent unit and the parent waits on them.

decomposition.description: atomic = a single independent deliverable (this node becomes a build leaf). split = more than one independent unit; emit children[].

plan_path.description: Filesystem path to the C2-rendered plan for this node. Present (and used by the code-gen stage) when decomposition is atomic; absent/ignored when split.

children.description: Required when decomposition is 'split'. One descriptor per independent child work unit, in build order.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the child work unit.

spec_seed.description: Brief spec-seed (goal + scope) that C1 /spec-write expands into the child's full spec.

rationale.description: Why this is an independent unit and how it relates to the parent goal.
